en: A black and white historical image showing a large, rectangular institutional building with two stories and many arched windows. The building is set on a slight slope, with a grassy area and small trees in the foreground. The text at the top identifies the building as a county hospital's surgical department. The overall appearance suggests an early 20th-century European setting.
